messages:
marco: Heads-up: opened PR #4198 to standardize SDK snippets for pagination + streaming across py/ts/go. Main changes: use async paginate API, show retry-with-jitter helper, and add a short note about server-side prefix caching. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4198

ingrid: skimming now. Are we renaming the python helper to `paginate_async()`? We used different names previously, want to avoid churn.

marco: yes; new name is `paginate_async()` to match TS `paginateAsync()` and Go `PaginateAsync`. Keeping parity is the goal.

devon: quick TS nit: example should use `for await` with try/catch around the stream so we can apply retry logic on transient errors. e.g.:
```js
for await (const page of client.items.paginateAsync(params)) {
  try {
    page.items.forEach(process)
  } catch (err) {
    // retry handling here
  }
}
```

kai: Go example uses a channel-based iterator, example draft:
```go
pages := client.Items.PaginateAsync(ctx, params)
for p := range pages {
    for _, it := range p.Items {
        handle(it)
    }
}
```
Add a short comment about closing the channel on errors.

ingrid: docs-bot flagged an internal link to /guides/pagination-old. I replaced it in the PR to /guides/pagination.

devon: retry helper suggestion (language-agnostic) in the doc: exponential backoff with jitter and max attempts; show pseudo-code block plus real examples per language.

marco: also adding a "stability note": if a caller mixes streaming responses (streaming endpoint) and cursor-based pagination calls against the same logical session, server-side prefix caching could return previously-cached prefixes. Recommend unique request_id per logical query or use test flag `cache_control: no-store` when reproducing issues.

eng-runtime-bot: FYI from eng-runtime: prefix caching behavior is intended for optimizing short repeated queries; it's not guaranteed across mixed streaming/pagination patterns. Recommend docs wording: "avoid interleaving streaming reads and cursor paging on the same request id unless you explicitly manage cache control."

marco: thanks @eng-runtime-bot — adding that sentence verbatim.

kai: added Go retry example using backoff + jitter. Left a small note about context cancellation semantics.

ingrid: small copy edit: change `PaginateAsync` to `Paginate` in Go sample to match SDK surface; otherwise LGTM.

devon: I pushed the TS retry-with-jitter snippet and a tiny improvement to the TS streaming example to await the async iterator properly.

docs-bot: lint: code-style OK. link-checker: 1 replaced link /guides/pagination-old -> /guides/pagination.

marco: can folks please +1 if ready to merge? We want this in the next docs cut.

ingrid: +1 (signed off).

kai: +1, fixed Go name.

devon: +1.

marco: merging after green CI. Will ping eng-runtime for a quick thumbs-up post-merge to confirm the cache wording.

marco: merged (gh:4198). Closing thread.
